result.methodology: Tests two real, mechanical signals from the live Insider Trading logic against what the stock actually did afterward - not a backtest of the free-tier LLM's live grounded predictions (those are generated fresh each time and there is no stored point-in-time data to replay them against). signal 'single_buy': every real SEC Form 4 officer/director buy found in the window. signal 'cluster_buy': 2+ distinct insiders buying the same stock within 7 days (the highest-conviction version of the same signal). For each real historical occurrence, this measures the stock's actual forward return using real historical closing prices.
result.data_sources: Real SEC Form 4 filing history (data.sec.gov) + real historical daily closes (Yahoo Finance)
result.caveat: Small sample size for a handful of large-cap tickers over 6 months - read percentages as directional, not a statistically robust edge. This does not measure the accuracy of the live LLM-generated predictions themselves.
